quests.title: Orobashi's Legacy: Part III

dialogue.t: The strange stone lantern seems to emit an ominous energy.
Is this... a stone lantern? Why is there a stone lantern here?
Well, someone's written something on the lamp post. Shall we go have a look?
"Fellow workers, if you have any questions about this ward, please go to the Musoujin Gorge and talk to Mr. Kaji."
The handwriting looks new. There are a few small rough lines of writing below:
"I'm sorry, but we can't help you either. We just received evacuation orders from the commissioner yesterday.
"I hope I can see you again someday and discuss how to solve our Tatarigami problem."
This Mr. Kaji seems to be pretty concerned about these stone lanterns. Why don't we go to Musoujin Gorge and ask him?
The lantern has finally been repaired. The weather seems to have changed as well.
Something seems to be missing from this ward. Let's try to find it with Elemental Sight, shall we?
It seems that two critical components are missing from the ward.

quests.description: The ward at the Jakotsu Mine has been damaged. It awaits your urgent repair.
